description: This file defines the DeleteFeatureStrategy class, which handles the logic for executing a delete feature command on a Thing entity within the Ditto framework. It includes methods for extracting features, generating results, and managing entity tags related to feature deletion events.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the deletion of a feature within a Thing entity in response to a DeleteFeature command. It extends AbstractThingCommandStrategy and provides implementations for applying the command, extracting features, generating deletion events, and managing entity tags.

methods.name: DeleteFeatureStrategy
methods.description: Constructor for the DeleteFeatureStrategy. Calls the superclass constructor with the DeleteFeature class.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the delete feature command, verifying the feature exists in the provided Thing entity, and returning either a success or error result.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Extracts the specified feature from a Thing entity, returning an Optional containing the feature if found.

methods.name: getDeleteFeatureResult
methods.description: Creates and returns a result representing the deletion event and response for a successful feature deletion.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag associated with the previous state of the feature to support concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional, indicating no specific entity tag is set for the next state after deletion.
